title: grid warp cubic
explanation:
### Description

Demonstrate 2D image warping with cubic interpolation using vtkThinPlateSplineTransform, vtkTransformToGrid, and vtkGridTransform.

**dataset → input → filter → visual_asset → renderer → infrastructure → scene → interaction → output**

- [vtkBMPReader](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkBMPReader.html) — bmp reader.
- [vtkGridTransform](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkGridTransform.html) — grid transform.
- [vtkImageBlend](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkImageBlend.html) — image blend.
- [vtkImageGridSource](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkImageGridSource.html) — image grid source.
- [vtkImageMapToColors](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkImageMapToColors.html) — image map to colors.
- [vtkImageReslice](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkImageReslice.html) — image reslice.
- [vtkImageSlice](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkImageSlice.html) — image slice.
- [vtkImageSliceMapper](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkImageSliceMapper.html) — image slice mapper.
- [vtkInteractorStyleImage](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkInteractorStyleImage.html) — interactor style image.
- [vtkLookupTable](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkLookupTable.html) — maps scalar values to colors.
- [vtkPoints](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkPoints.html) — stores 3D point coordinates.
- [vtkThinPlateSplineTransform](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkThinPlateSplineTransform.html) — thin plate spline transform.
- [vtkTransformToGrid](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkTransformToGrid.html) — transform to grid.
- [vtkRenderWindow](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkRenderWindow.html) — displays the rendered scene in a window on screen.
- [vtkRenderWindowInteractor](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkRenderWindowInteractor.html) — captures mouse and keyboard events.
- [vtkRenderer](https://www.vtk.org/doc/nightly/html/classvtkRenderer.html) — assembles the scene and configures the camera.
- `Initialize()` and `Start()` launch the interactive visualization — `Initialize()` prepares the interactor and `Start()` begins the event loop.
